description: Demo_Game teaching station definitions. Each station is a named in-world landmark that demonstrates a specific engine feature. Students can add new stations by extending this array and rerunning the game.

stations.description: Cook-Torrance BRDF: GGX NDF + Smith G + Schlick F, IBL split-sum, Reinhard tonemapping, gamma correction.
Directional shadow map 512x512, PCF 3x3 SamplerComparisonState, LDR bloom 5-tap Gaussian blur.
SkyRenderer time-of-day clock, WeatherFx fog density and rain intensity, procedural sun disc.
Rigid-body simulation, character capsule step-up, raycast hit detection, AABB hit volumes.
X3DAudio DSP path, distance attenuation, SetListenerPosition, per-frame ECS TransformComponent read.
64-joint skinned mesh, GpuSkinningBuffer DYNAMIC CB, Two-Bone IK (law of cosines) + FABRIK iterative IK.
BtTree FSM, BtSequence / BtSelector, FormationSystem LINE/V_SHAPE/CIRCLE, A* NavMesh grid pathfinding.
QuestSystem objective tracking, prerequisite gating, DialogueSystem in-range NPC conversation trees.
WorldStreamingManager async cell load/evict, AsyncLoader worker thread, frame-budget cap, ImGui minimap.
Heightmap-driven grid mesh (TRN1 binary format), height-based colour blend, Lambert + Reinhard tonemap.
CinematicSequencer shot/cut, CameraRig keyframe Lerp, timed audio events, OnComplete callback.
IDLE/BUILDING/COOLDOWN FSM, prefix-match combo chains, window expiry, damage formula testing.
